title: n0x-content Cutlist
description: JSON Schema for the n0x-content kinetic video cutlist. Validates segment structure, phase durations, filter adjacency, and filter-effect compatibility. Synchronized with main.py cutlist ingestion and filter-effect-matrix.json.

end.description: End timestamp in seconds. Must be > start.

text.description: UPPERCASE overlay text, 2-5 words. Null for flash/strobe frames.

asset.description: Relative path to source file from project root. Null for generated frames (e.g. white_flash segments).

filter.description: Visual filter. Must be compatible with the segment's effect per filter-effect-matrix.json.

effect.description: Motion effect. No-op effects (strobe, word_flash) are valid with any filter including white_flash.

clip_start.description: Subclip start offset in seconds within the source asset. Omit or set to 0 to use the asset from its start.

clip_end.description: Subclip end offset in seconds within the source asset. Omit to auto-compute from segment duration.

$comment: Cross-field rules (end > start, timeline continuity, filter adjacency) are enforced by src/validator.py; JSON Schema cannot express cross-field comparisons.

noGaps.description: Segments must be contiguous: segment[i].end == segment[i+1].start for all i.

filterAdjacency.description: No two consecutive segments may use the same filter.

filterEffectCompatibility.description: If filter is 'white_flash', effect must be null or an identity effect (strobe, word_flash). Motion effects on white_flash are nonsensical.

textUppercase.description: All non-null text must be UPPERCASE, 2-5 words.
textUppercase.check: segment.text == null or (segment.text == segment.text.toUpperCase() and 2 <= wordCount <= 5)

assetRequiredUnlessGenerated.description: asset must be non-null unless the segment is a generated frame (white_flash filter, or no filter with null asset).

textNullOnFlash.description: Text should be null on white_flash segments.
